# Journey Office Builders

> Journey Office Builders (JOB), Journey Office Builders LLC, is a tenant improvement general contractor based at 8455-Y Tyco Road, Vienna, VA 22182, serving Washington DC, Northern Virginia and Maryland since 1989. Phone 703-748-4600, info@excellentjob.com.

- Services: tenant improvements and office fit-outs, white-box/spec suites, building renovations and capital improvements, SCIF construction, demolition, commercial flooring, painting and wall finishes, preconstruction and capital planning, permitting, punch-list and closeout, ongoing tenant services.
- Specialty: construction in occupied commercial buildings.
- Licenses: Virginia Class A #2705020320; Washington DC #71102579; Maryland #15356747. Fully licensed and insured.
- Federal registration: UEI KCKWP7QAF157, CAGE 8V9X6. SAM Certified.
- Leadership: Richard Asala (President), Werner Parrilla (VP, Operations and Business Development), Scott Johnson (VP, Construction Services).
- 35+ years experience, 500+ projects completed.
